text: very fruitful hill: Heb. the horn of the son of oil | fenced it: Or, made a wall about it | made: Heb. hewed
his pleasant plant: Heb. plant of his pleasures | oppression: Heb. a scab
in mine ears said the LORD: Or, this is in mine ears saith the LORD, etc. | of a truth: Heb. if not, etc.
their honourable men are famished: Heb. their glory are men of famine
God that is holy: Or, the holy God, Heb. The God the holy
that call evil good: Heb. that say concerning evil, It is good, etc.
in their own sight: before their face
the fire: Heb. the tongue of fire
sorrow: Or, distress | and the light is darkened in the heavens thereof: Or, when it is light it shall be dark in the destructions thereof
